properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is a JWT signature algorithm using RSA with SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 hashes. It's used for authenticating JWT tokens in this JavaScript library which leverages the browser's native web crypto API.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is a JWT signature algorithm using HMAC-SHA-256. It's used for signing JWT tokens in this JavaScript library which leverages the browser's native web crypto API. While it's not as urgent as RSA signatures, it's still classical cryptography.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is RSA encryption/decryption using RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashes. It's used for signing JWT tokens in this JavaScript library which leverages the browser's native web crypto API. This is a quantum-vulnerable algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is AES-CBC encryption used for JWT encryption in this JavaScript library. CBC mode without authenticated encryption is vulnerable to malleability attacks and should be replaced with authenticated modes like AES-GCM.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is JWT signature algorithm using ECDSA with P-256, P-384 and P-521 curves. It's used for signing JWT tokens in this JavaScript library which leverages the browser's native web crypto API. ECDSA is vulnerable to quantum attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: These are ECDSA signatures using NIST P-384 and P-521 curves. While these curves provide strong security against classical attacks, they are still vulnerable to quantum attacks and should be migrated to post-quantum alternatives.
